textbookBox.concept: Think about when you go to play after school, who you play with, where, and when you come back home.

beats.en: Think about when you go to play after school, who you play with, where, and when you come back home. The poem is about an evening game of ball played by children, so it is about playing, running and the end of the day.

beats.en: The speaker and friends play ball in the evenings next to a creek, in the neighbour's field. A creek is a small body of water.

textbookBox.ref: CBSE Class 6 english · The Winner · Deeper Textbook Ideas
textbookBox.concept: The sky changing from blue to black tells us that the colour of the sky changes as evening becomes night.

beats.en: The sky changing from blue to black tells us that the colour of the sky changes as evening becomes night. Trees seem to creep close because in the dark they look larger and nearer, and it is hard to see far.
beats.speakEn: The sky changing from blue to black tells us that the colour of the sky changes as evening becomes night. Trees seem to creep close because in the dark they look larger and nearer, and it is hard to see far.

beats.en: Repetition, as in a pattern repeating a word, can highlight a feeling. Example: the leaves are falling, falling, falling. Personification gives human qualities to things that are not alive.
